# Third-Party Licenses

<!-- regenerated by CI; see deny.toml -->

This file aggregates the licenses of every third-party dependency vendored
into a Concerto release artifact. It is regenerated at release time via
`cargo about generate` (wired up in Task 53) and validated on every CI run
against the allow-list in `deny.toml`.

The workspace currently has no third-party Rust dependencies declared in any
member crate, so this file is intentionally a stub. Apache-2.0 attribution
obligations are aggregated in `NOTICE` at the repo root.
